# OSPFv2 Opaque LSA (`ospfv2_opaque_lsa`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: 20 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [OSPF Opaque / SR, BGP MP / VPN / EVPN (P2)](../../protocols/routing-ext.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ospfv2_lsa`](ospfv2_lsa.md) | `ls_type` | 9 (0x09) – 11 (0x0b) (re-decodes this layer) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ls_age` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   | Time since the LSA was originated, in seconds (keep 0 for an exact Auto checksum). |
| `options` | `flags(8)` | `0x42` |   | Optional capabilities (E, MC, N/P, L, DC, O, DN bits). |
| `ls_type` | `enum(8)` | `10` (area_opaque) |   | Opaque LSA flooding scope (9 = link-local, 10 = area, 11 = AS). |
| `opaque_type` | `enum(8)` | `4` (router_information) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | Opaque type (1 = TE, 4 = Router Information, 7 = Extended Prefix, 8 = Extended Link; Auto from the body layer). |
| `opaque_id` | `uint(24)` | `0` |   | Opaque ID distinguishing LSAs of the same opaque type (24 bits). |
| `advertising_router` | `ipv4` | `192.0.2.1` |   | Router ID of the router that originated the LSA. |
| `ls_sequence` | `uint(32)` | `2147483649` |   | LSA sequence number (0x80000001 = initial). |
| `ls_checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Fletcher checksum over the header and everything after it; `ls_age` counted as zero | Fletcher checksum of the LSA without LS age (Auto). |
| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets | Length of the LSA including its header, in octets (Auto). |

### `options`

| Bit | Mask | Name |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 (0x01) | `mt` |
| 1 | 2 (0x02) | `e` |
| 2 | 4 (0x04) | `mc` |
| 3 | 8 (0x08) | `np` |
| 4 | 16 (0x10) | `l` |
| 5 | 32 (0x20) | `dc` |
| 6 | 64 (0x40) | `o` |
| 7 | 128 (0x80) | `dn` |

### `ls_type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 9 (0x09) | `link_local_opaque` |
| 10 (0x0a) | `area_opaque` |
| 11 (0x0b) | `as_opaque` |

### `opaque_type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | `traffic_engineering` |
| 4 (0x04) | `router_information` |
| 7 (0x07) | `extended_prefix` |
| 8 (0x08) | `extended_link` |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `opaque_type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | [`ospfv2_te_lsa`](ospfv2_te_lsa.md) |   |
| 4 (0x04) | [`ospfv2_ri_lsa`](ospfv2_ri_lsa.md) |   |
| 7 (0x07) | [`ospfv2_ext_prefix_lsa`](ospfv2_ext_prefix_lsa.md) |   |
| 8 (0x08) | [`ospfv2_ext_link_lsa`](ospfv2_ext_link_lsa.md) |   |

## Constraints

| Level | Rule |
|---|---|
| warning | `ls_type` within 9..11 |
